metadata.title: Resolución ARCSA-DE-2025-052-DASP, Normativa Técnica Sanitaria Sustitutiva para el Funcionamiento del Sistema Nacional de Farmacovigilancia (SNFV)
metadata.edition: R.O. N° 218 of 4 February 2026 · Art. 3: plazos in calendar days; the PDF could be read only to Art. 22, the reporting articles were not read, so the rulebook has no clock from 4 February 2026 (Spanish)
metadata.legal_basis: ARCSA resolution published in the Registro Oficial; the official Spanish text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
